data.name: Ikseer
data.gender_notes: Ikseer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is on a journey or quest in search of knowledge or truth. This name is derived from the Arabic root ‘ksr’, meaning 'to seek'. The name Ikseer carries the meaning “Seeker, Wanderer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ikseer usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker, wanderer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are on a spiritual journey, seeking knowledge and truth to enrich their lives and grow closer to God.
data.etymology: Ikseer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeker, Wanderer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ikseer total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إكسير
in_arabic.meaning: إكسير هو اسم يعني بالعربية السريرة أو الخفية
in_arabic.long_meaning: إكسير هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ك-س-ر' والذي يحمل معاني السريرة والخفية. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم إكسير لوصف الشخص الذي يحمل أسرارًا أو معلومات خفية. وفي بعض السياقات، يمكن أن يشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بفهم عميق أو رؤية داخلية.

in_urdu.name: اکسیر
in_urdu.meaning: اکسیر کا مطلب ہے خفیہ یا پوشیدہ چیز
in_urdu.long_meaning: اکسیر ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ک-س-ر' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خفیہ یا پوشیدہ۔ یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو خفیہ معلومات یا سر رکھتے ہیں۔ اس نام کا روحانی مطلب یہ ہے کہ جو شخص اس نام کو رکھتا ہے وہ گہری سمجھ یا بصیرت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इक्सीर
in_hindi.meaning: इक्सीर का अर्थ है छुपी हुई या रहस्यमयी बात
in_hindi.long_meaning: इक्सीर एक अरबी नाम है जो 'क-स-र' मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है छुपी हुई या रहस्यमयी। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो छुपी हुई जानकारी या रहस्य रखते हैं। इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक अर्थ यह है कि जो व्यक्ति इस नाम को रखता है वह गहरी समझ या अंतर्दृष्टि रखता है।

in_pashto.name: إکسير
in_pashto.meaning: إکسير د پټ یا رازنيک چاڼ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: إکسير د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چي د 'ک-س-ر' په جذر پورې اړه لري، مانا يې د پټ یا رازنيک. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چي پټ معلومات یا رازونه لري. د دې نوم روحاني معنی دا ده چي څوک چي دا نوم لري هغه ژوره پوهه یا لیدلوری لري.

in_english.name: Ikseer
in_english.meaning: Ikseer means secret or hidden thing in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Ikseer is an Arabic name derived from the root 'k-s-r', which carries meanings of secret or hidden. This name is used for individuals who possess hidden knowledge or secrets. The spiritual significance of Ikseer implies that the bearer has a deep understanding or insight. Historically, names with similar roots have been used in Islamic tradition to signify wisdom, knowledge, and mysticism.

This name serves as a reminder to constantly seek knowledge and wisdom, as well as a reminder of the ultimate purpose and goal of life, which is to serve and please Allah. Additionally, the name "Ikseer" carries a deep sense of purpose and motivation, inspiring individuals to strive for excellence and to continuously improve themselves in both their spiritual and worldly pursuits.

historical_references.context: The name Ikseer is mentioned as a Berber leader who rebelled against Muslim rule in Ifriqiya, North Africa, and was eventually defeated by the Umayyad general Hassan ibn al-Nu'man.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Bakri's Description of Africa The name Ikseer carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ikseer is mentioned as the king of the Zanj, a black population in southern Iraq, who revolted against the Abbasid Caliphate. He is described as a man of great military prowess and was able to maintain control over a large portion of the region for several years before ultimately being defeated and killed by the Caliphate forces.
